title: Prototype flow file (<Screen>.flow.json), version 1
description: What Cuvara.UIToolkit.Prototype.PrototypeRunner plays for one screen. Written by the penpot-uitoolkit-bridge converter (bridge/flow.py build_flow). See PROTOTYPE-FLOW.md for the version rule and the meaning of each field. Fields not listed here are allowed and ignored by the runner (the converter writes more for its own gates).

version.description: Major version of the format. The runner rejects any other value.

overlay.description: True when another screen opens this one as an overlay. Informational.

size.description: Board size [width, height] in px. Informational.

start.description: Start screen of the flow (used when the runner has no StartScreen).

name.description: Name of a ScrollView in the screen; the runner adds drag scrolling.

mode.description: Vertical | Horizontal | VerticalAndHorizontal (informational: the ScrollView's own mode is used).

motion.description: Motion policy of the profile. Missing: back = reverse, enabled = true.

back.description: What previous-screen plays: the reverse of the navigation it undoes, or nothing.

enabled.description: false: no screen or overlay transition is animated.

element.description: Name of the element in the screen's UXML.

target.description: Destination screen; close-overlay without one closes the overlay that contains the element.

position.description: Overlay position: center (default), top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right, manual.

durationMs.description: Below 1 the interaction is not animated.

direction.description: slide and push: direction of motion.

type.description: C# type of the element: Button, Toggle, TextField.

motion.description: Motion preset name of the control.

name.description: Name of the list element (a ListView, a ScrollView or a plain container).

template.description: Name of the item template UXML (informational).

selectable.description: true: single selection (class selected, Selected element).
